title: Tensor-network Monte Carlo approach based on time-evolving block decimation
summary: We propose a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) approach for unitary evolution following the compression sequence of the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) algorithm. In the TNMC approach, the obtained results contain evaluable statistical errors rather than truncation errors, unlike ordinary singular-value-decomposition-based methods such as the TEBD algorithm. Consequently, one can estimate unbiased expectation values within statistical errors even with a finite bond dimension.
